decisions.reason: The articulated dumper builds on the firm's core construction engineering and its visible investment, and after only two years on the market weak or missing evidence is still read as a normal ramp-up, so it is kept.

The mine rescue vehicle absorbed substantial specialized development and public commitment in a long-cycle niche, so slow results are attributed to temporary procurement delays rather than failure, and it is kept.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line is the firm's largest visible investment and central to its lifting core, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The material lift line is close to the established offer and is reported as the most popular rental lift, with a recent large order, so it is clearly kept.

Although the compact mining loader is distant from the established offer, the firm publicly reports strong field results of 1,000 operating hours in seven months, which justifies and reinforces the investment, so it is kept.
